omissions.reason: Dialog admission uses the MASK part; no Portal prototype is catalogued or projected.

Dashboard capability snapshots do not yet provide typed current values for mutable hardware controls.
BIOS confirmation stays unavailable until a typed read/modify/write request and readback contract exists.
The available Linux evidence is headless; no DISPLAY or WAYLAND_DISPLAY desktop run is recorded.
Windows CI compilation/tests do not prove GUI rendering, AccessKit delivery, or hardware behavior.

uncataloged_capabilities.reason: The governed registry exposes a CloseIcon entry, but ProtoDialogHost does not project it and no native evidence proves it; it is excluded from the canonical 33 IDs.

wire_policy.allowed: Typed protocol envelopes and bounded serde JSON primitives, arrays, and maps.
wire_policy.runtime_import_policy: The bridge imports @proto.ui/runtime only from its public package root.

authority_tiers.upstream_manifest: Recorded source manifest and generated-bundle identity; authoritative for revisions and digests.
authority_tiers.upstream_runtime: Pinned Proto-UI Runtime/Vitest execution; authoritative for Web-shaped Runtime behavior only.
authority_tiers.upstream_catalog: Pinned prototype-catalog checker; authoritative for upstream declarations and registry accounting only.
authority_tiers.upstream_types: Pinned type/doc checks; authoritative for package type consistency only.
authority_tiers.upstream_web_comparison: Pinned web-conformance comparison; Web comparison evidence, explicitly not GPUI evidence.
authority_tiers.upstream_portable_and_web_only: Full upstream portable test suite (Runtime Vitest plus browser and catalog/release/types/style/component/agent checks); portable/Web-shaped evidence only, never native GPUI proof.
authority_tiers.local_bundle_tool: Sailbreak's Bun build/check tooling; authoritative for the checked-in bundle bytes only.
authority_tiers.runtime_fake_host: proto-ui-gpui Runtime, fake-host, and host-capability contract tests; not native GPUI proof.
authority_tiers.host_capability: Data-only focus, overlay, lifecycle, and projection capability contracts; not a rendered desktop proof.
authority_tiers.native_gpui: sailbreak-gui native projection and AccessKit/dogfood contracts; native API/type evidence without a display smoke.
authority_tiers.desktop_smoke: Not currently recorded; this tier requires an actual Linux or Windows display-session run.
authority_tiers.windows_ci: Windows CI compile/test evidence only; never GUI, AccessKit, or hardware proof by itself.
authority_tiers.local_workspace: Sailbreak Cargo contracts, checks, clippy, and release build at the recorded worktree; local build evidence, not desktop or hardware proof.

runtime_fake_host.result: Component, protocol, template, style, Runtime, and stale/lifecycle contracts exercise decoded Runtime and fake-host paths.

host_capability.result: Focus, overlay, data-only ordering, stale rejection, and lease disposal are covered at the host-capability boundary.

desktop_smoke.result: Linux remains headless until an actual DISPLAY or WAYLAND_DISPLAY run is recorded; no Windows GUI smoke is recorded.

windows_ci.result: CI compilation/tests may establish build coverage but cannot establish GUI, AccessKit, or hardware behavior.

matrix.implementation: upstream.json identity is consumed by QuickJsBridge and linked to the embedded bundle digest.
matrix.limitation: The source is an unreleased Proto-UI main snapshot; this identity does not imply official Adapter conformance.

matrix.implementation: Family hosts serialize props into the pinned Runtime and project typed snapshots for all eleven families.
matrix.limitation: Runtime/fake-host coverage is not native proof; facade snapshots retain acknowledged props/default fallbacks when Runtime state is absent.

matrix.implementation: Runtime state and exposed values are decoded into family snapshots and native intent.
matrix.limitation: State remains limited: the listed component facades fall back to props/defaults for missing Runtime values, and no display-session evidence proves native state delivery.

matrix.implementation: Exposed Runtime state maps are retained in data-only SessionSnapshot values and consumed by family hosts.
matrix.limitation: Expose/state assertions are Runtime/fake-host proof only; facade fallback paths are acknowledged rather than treated as native semantic truth.

matrix.implementation: Native input facts are normalized into data-only Runtime commands and semantic signals are counted once.
matrix.limitation: Exact-once fake-host and source-level native wiring do not prove an actual desktop event loop; semantic fallback limitations remain enumerated.

matrix.implementation: FocusRegistry and proto_surface focus subscriptions translate opaque focus targets and input sources.
matrix.limitation: Focus readiness and routing are host-capability contracts; no actual display smoke proves native focus delivery.

matrix.implementation: TemplateSnapshot carries anonymous containers/text, semantic IDs, and replacement pruning through the data-only dialect.
matrix.limitation: Template round-trip is fake-host evidence; native projection is not visually verified without a desktop run.

matrix.implementation: SlotProjection preserves accessible content alternatives while native callers attach caller-owned Slot subtrees.
matrix.limitation: Slot data and host composition are contract evidence; visual/native child layout remains unproven in the headless environment.

matrix.implementation: Shadcn semantic tokens are translated into NativeStyle with named unsupported-token diagnostics.
matrix.limitation: Translator tests do not establish pixel parity or native visual delivery; unsupported tokens remain diagnostics rather than hidden fallbacks.

matrix.implementation: SVG nodes and attributes are represented in TemplateNode and projected as data for native rendering.
matrix.limitation: SVG structure is round-tripped and consumed by host code, but no display smoke proves its native paint result.

matrix.implementation: A11ySnapshot intent is projected by proto_surface and project_a11y into the pinned GPUI AccessKit surface.
matrix.limitation: AccessKit contracts and native source are not an actual desktop accessibility tree observation; state fallback paths also limit semantic certainty.

matrix.implementation: Rust-owned OverlayHost leases positioning, layer order, dismissal, presence, and stale revision checks for Select, Dropdown, Dialog, and Hover Card.
matrix.limitation: Overlay leases and geometry are host-capability evidence; actual native stacking and placement are not display-smoke verified.

matrix.implementation: Session, family graph, overlay lease, and text-control lifecycles dispose through explicit terminal paths.
matrix.limitation: Lifecycle tests prove data/lease cleanup in fake hosts; they do not prove cleanup after a real native window teardown.

matrix.implementation: Remount advances view epochs and reprojects family graphs without reusing stale native leases.
matrix.limitation: Epoch behavior is locally verified at the Runtime/host boundary; no desktop remount smoke is recorded.

matrix.implementation: Session epochs, route references, commit IDs, overlay revisions, and sequences reject stale input before semantic dispatch.
matrix.limitation: The rejection invariant is data-only/host-capability evidence and is not a claim about unobserved native hardware behavior.

matrix.implementation: Dispose is terminal and idempotent across sessions, family members, text controls, and overlay leases.
matrix.limitation: Terminal cleanup is locally exercised without a real display teardown or cross-process host restart.

matrix.implementation: Linux dashboard composition and display gating are implemented in sailbreak-gui with the same Proto family projections.
matrix.limitation: Current Linux evidence is headless only: run returns the display-channel error until DISPLAY or WAYLAND_DISPLAY is available; no visual desktop smoke is claimed.

matrix.implementation: The workspace and GUI sources are covered by the Windows CI build/test path.
matrix.limitation: Windows CI compilation/tests are not GUI, AccessKit, display, or hardware proof; no Windows desktop smoke is recorded.

limitations.semantic_fallback_policy: These facades use props/default fallbacks only when the corresponding Runtime state value is absent. The fallback paths are acknowledged limitations; they are not evidence that Runtime state or native semantic state is complete.
limitations.native_evidence_boundary: Native proof is limited to sailbreak-gui proto_surface.rs plus AccessKit/dogfood contracts and an actual display smoke. proto-ui-gpui tests alone are Runtime/fake-host/host-capability proof.
limitations.linux: Headless only until an actual display session supplies visual and accessibility evidence.
limitations.windows: CI compilation/tests do not prove GUI, AccessKit, or hardware behavior.
limitations.upstream_admission: Any external contribution is HAL-free and maintainer-gated; no official Proto-UI GPUI Adapter claim exists before upstream review and complete native evidence.

upstream_slices.scope: Bounded data-only protocol envelopes, identity/epoch validation, projection ACKs, and lease shapes.
upstream_slices.admission_gate: Proto-UI maintainer review; preserve transport-neutral semantics.

upstream_slices.scope: GPUI host capability realization, focus/overlay lifecycle, stale rejection, disposal, and reviewed AccessKit ports.
upstream_slices.admission_gate: Maintainer review plus native GPUI evidence at an admitted revision.

upstream_slices.scope: Generic Template, Slot, SVG, style-token, and unsupported-capability translation independent of Sailbreak UI.
upstream_slices.admission_gate: Schema and projection review; no visual parity claim without the upstream evidence gate.

upstream_slices.scope: One Adapter-profile pull request per Shadcn family, with copied public semantics separated from original Rust host translation.
upstream_slices.admission_gate: Maintainer admission for the exact Proto-UI HEAD and declared profile; registry presence alone is insufficient.

upstream_slices.scope: Versioned profile metadata, omission/uncataloged declarations, authority-tiered evidence, and reproducible source/bundle identity.
upstream_slices.admission_gate: Maintainer review; web comparison and dogfood evidence must not be presented as official GPUI conformance.
